values.binNote: Wiki's pp|125 to 250 does not match the 5-rank MonsterDamage array [150/175/200/225/250]; the bin's SettE#MonsterBonus byLevel(125..250) appears to be the actual source read by the tooltip, a separate level-scaled value from MonsterDamage.

values.quote: '''''Sett''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Facebreaker's cast time.''

mechanics.claim: Sett automatically follows up with a basic attack on the closest enemy pulled in by Facebreaker.
mechanics.quote: '''Sett''' will afterwards attempt to basic attack the closest target picked up by ''Facebreaker'', prioritising champions and prioritising those in front of him.

mechanics.claim: Facebreaker's cast generates an extra Hail of Blades stack despite not being a basic attack reset.
mechanics.quote: ''Facebreaker's'' cast generates an additional stack of {{ri|Hail of Blades}} despite the ability not {{tip|basic attack reset|resetting}} his basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: If Facebreaker hits no enemies, Sett's Haymaker (W) is also locked out for 0.25 seconds after the cast time.
mechanics.quote: If ''Facebreaker'' does not hit an enemy, {{ai|Haymaker|Sett}} is also unable to be cast for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after the cast time.

mechanics.claim: Stunning requires hitting at least one enemy on each side of Sett; targets behind spell shields don't count toward this requirement.
mechanics.quote: Targets protected by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}} don't count toward the requirement to {{tip|stun}}.
